title: Virtual Compute: snapshot allocation — snapshot origin
content:
## Applicable basis

Virtual Compute snapshot allocation — This shared-snapshot reconciliation scope selects the most recent posted supplemental snapshot charge of the selected holding, identified exactly by the customer.

Virtual Compute snapshot allocation — Read the authoritative snapshot export reference of that most recent posted supplemental snapshot charge.

Virtual Compute snapshot allocation — Use the UTC service service month recorded on that latest posted supplemental snapshot charge.

## Basis Q&A

**What is the judgement for snapshot allocation — snapshot origin?**

Use the UTC service service month recorded on that latest posted supplemental snapshot charge.
